title: Panelists claiming trade agreements with other planets

tellings.quote: on a a panel with guys I mean who insisted that we have trade agreements with other planets and stuff and we're we're trading back and forth.

plain: An author, Peter Levenda, says that he once sat on a conference panel with people who insisted that humans already have trade agreements with other planets. According to Levenda, they claimed goods were being traded back and forth. He tells it as an example of the claims he has heard first-hand, which would mean open contact with other worlds if true.
